title: China's Coal Import Prospects Remain Very Bullish
section_path: China's Coal Import Prospects Remain Very Bullish
section_path_text: China's Coal Import Prospects Remain Very Bullish
summary:
Main
By Jeffrey Landsberg
As we have continued to discuss in Commodore Research's Weekly Executive Reports and Weekly China Reports, it has remained incredibly helpful for the dry bulk market that coal production in China is coming under significant government-mandated pressure following May's catastrophic coal mine accident. Image reference: Chart 1.jpg | assets/2026-08-06_chinas-coal-import-prospects-remain-very-bullish_img_chart1_90877a3247b7.jpg
Also very helpful is that thermal coal burn is surging. Thermal coal burn at China's six major power plants has set another 2026 record this week and remains well above last year's burn level.
